item.title: Federal lawsuit claims Arkansas is denying due process for its ‘sham’ parole revocation system
item.description: A lawsuit filed in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Arkansas alleges that the state's parole revocation proceedings are unconstitutional, denying inmates their right to due process, legal representation, and accommodation for disabilities.

item.title: Three rescued from frozen pond near Fayetteville apartment complex
item.description: The Fayetteville Fire Department says three people, including one child, were pulled from a frozen pond on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Clintons reverse course, agree to testify in House Epstein inquiry
item.description: Former President Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton have agreed to testify before the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee as part of the panel's investigation into the convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. item.title: Sheridan youth gymnastics center closed for foreseeable future after winter storm
item.description: Pinnacle Gymnastics in Sheridan will be closed for the foreseeable future, after heavy ice and snow accumulation on the facility's rooftop caused support beams to buckle.

item.title: Newport residents without running water as volunteers step in to help
item.description: Some residents in Newport say they’ve been living without reliable running water for weeks, forcing families to rely on bottled water to meet their most basic needs.

item.title: Schools across central Arkansas open back up after over a week of cancellations from winter weather
item.description: The Little Rock School District announced its campuses would be open on Tuesday, starting at regular hours after six consecutive days of cancellations from snow and ice.

item.title: Little Rock Christian Academy star JJ Andrews named to McDonald’s All American game
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. – The McDonald’s All-American game unveiled its rosters for the 49th edition on Monday which include Arkansas native JaShawn “JJ” Andrews. item.title: Waste Management offering extra trash drop-off for unincorporated Pulaski County residents
item.description: For those with extra trash due to the recent winter weather, there is now a chance of a bit more relief.

item.title: Garland County election building damaged by winter storm as early voting approaches, officials say election will continue
item.description: Early voting for the upcoming primary and judicial election is set to begin in just weeks, but Garland County election officials are working through an unexpected setback after last week’s winter storm caused significant damage to the county’s election commission building.

item.title: 'Glass was shooting out of the garage,' Conway woman recounts Monday morning house fire
item.description: A Conway woman is picking up the pieces after her home was damaged by a fire that happened early Monday morning.
